name: sasha-desktop
description: Sasha Desktop — the window your AI-OS opens when it has something for you. Local-only, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run audit:deps && npm run audit:cve && npm run audit:surface && npm run typecheck && npm run test
